info.name: Wallet System
info.description:
Wallet System API. Configure BASE_URL and USER_PASSWORD in collection variables, then Sign Up, Login and Create Wallet. Login stores ACCESS_TOKEN and USER_ID; Create Wallet stores WALLET_ID. Set SOURCE_WALLET_ID to your funded wallet and DESTINATION_WALLET_ID to an existing recipient wallet in the same currency. Amounts are integer minor units, minimum 1000.

Wallet Transfer requires Idempotency-Key. Its pre-request script generates a UUID only when IDEMPOTENCY_KEY is empty, preserving it for retries. Keep the same body and key for Retry Transfer. Clear/change the key only for a deliberate new transfer. Reusing a key with a changed body returns 409. Requests above the server's approval threshold remain pending without reserving funds; retries return the original creation result even after review.

Set ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD for a pre-provisioned admin, then Login as Admin; signup cannot grant admin rights. Approval, rejection and history use ADMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN. Run these requests individually as a manual workflow; payment completion and admin provisioning require external steps. See postman_docs/README.md for setup and current API limitations.

Stored by Create Wallet; must belong to the signed-in account.
Positive integer minor units, at least 1000.
Reference from a completed successful Paystack payment initialized for this wallet/user.

Existing recipient wallet, distinct from source and with matching currency.
Positive integer minor units. Above MININUM_APPROVAL_AMOUNT (default 1000000) requires admin review.
Transfer reason; keep unchanged for retries.

Stored by successful transfer creation; only pending approval requests can be reviewed.
Email of an existing, trusted admin account.
Private password for that existing admin.
Stored by Login as Admin. Admin requests use this token separately from ACCESS_TOKEN.
Inclusive UTC start day in YYYY-MM-DD format; pair with TO_DATE.
Inclusive UTC final day in YYYY-MM-DD format; pair with FROM_DATE.

request.description: Login returns access_token, rotating refresh_token and refresh_expires_at. Five login attempts per minute per IP and account are allowed; an account block lasts five minutes. request.description: Admin-only UTC transaction history. Supply paired YYYY-MM-DD dates (inclusive final day, at most 366 days) or a paired month/year, never both. Omitting filters returns the last 30 UTC days. data.items is a page; data.next_cursor is null when finished. Keep the same filter while paging.
